title: Ɔhene no Ahobrɛase Kɛse
intro: Wohu wo ho wɔ tete anwonwade ne adiyisɛm a emu dɔ asase so. Sodifo bi a ɔwɔ tumi, a na ohyiaa nsato a na ɔnhwɛ kwan no fii akwantu bi a ɛbɛsakra ne nkrabea ne ne nkurɔfo gyidi ase. So wubetumi ahu onii ko a saa onipa kɛse yi yɛ?
clues: Midii ahenni a edi yiye, a wɔde ahonyade bebree ne ahengua a ɛyɛ nwonwa asiesie so so.
Me ne me nkurɔfo som ɔsoro nipadua bi, na yegye di sɛ ɛyɛ yɛn wura, ɛwom sɛ na mewɔ adwenem naayɛ wɔ m’akoma mu de.
Ɔbɔfo soronko bi, anomaa bi, de krataa bi kɔmaa me, na ɔfrɛɛ me ne me nkurɔfo sɛ yɛmmrɛ yɛn ho ase mma Onyankopɔn Baako no.
Mibisabisaa m’afotufo a na wɔn ahoɔden yɛ den no nsɛm faa sɛnea mɛyɛ nkrasɛm a ebi mmae da yi ho mmuae ho.
Meyɛɛ m’adwene sɛ mede akyɛde a ɛsom bo bɛmena nea ɔde krataa no kɔmaa no no, a na mewɔ anidaso sɛ mɛhwɛ ne tumi ne n’adwene.
Bere a miduu hɔ no, ahemfie bi a wɔde ahwehwɛ ayɛ fam, a ɛda adi sɛ nsu tare no maa me ho dwiriw me, na saa bere no na mepaee mu kae sɛ mɛbrɛ me ho ase ama abɔde nyinaa Awurade.

arabic: إِنِّى وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةًۭ تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
verse: Indeed, I found a woman ruling them and she has been given of every thing and for her (is) a throne great (23) (27:23)
